page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the arm64-based c4a server family. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable compute performance without resource contention from neighboring virtual machines.

This server configuration does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external networking configurations for public internet access.

The arm64 architecture provides a power-efficient hardware profile, making this instance qualitatively cost-effective for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive parallel processing power. Suitable workloads include database hosting, caching layers, in-memory analytics, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
